scripts.script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Rivals Hub - COMMANDS & MAX EDITION",
   LoadingTitle = "Loading Commands & Full Hub...",
   LoadingSubtitle = "by Rivals Hub",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
   Discord = { Enabled = false },
   KeySystem = true,
   KeySettings = {
      Title = "Rivals Hub | Key System",
      Subtitle = "Enter Key to Access",
      Note = "Password is: 123",
      FileName = "RivalsHubKey_123",
      SaveKey = false,
      GrabKeyFromSite = false,
      Key = {"123"},
      KeyLink = "https://lootlabs.gg"
   }
})

-- Services & Core Variables
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

local flying = false
local speed = 50
local walkSpeedValue = 16
local jumpPowerValue = 50
local spinSpeed = 0
local bodyVelocity, bodyGyro

-- States & Banned List
local bannedPlayers = {}
local noclipEnabled = false
local infJumpEnabled = false
local spectating = false
local fullbrightEnabled = false
local clickTPEnabled = false
local rainbowEnabled = false
local autoClickerEnabled = false

local originalBrightness = Lighting.Brightness
local originalClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime
local currentHighlight = nil

-- Fly Mechanics
local function startFlying()
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid then return end

	humanoid.PlatformStand = true

	bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * 100000
	bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bodyVelocity.Parent = root

	bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * 100000
	bodyGyro.CFrame = root.CFrame
	bodyGyro.Parent = root

	flying = true
end

local function stopFlying()
	flying = false
	if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
	if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() end

	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		end
	end
end

-- Helper Target Finder
local function findTarget(name)
	if not name or name == "" then return nil end
	name = name:lower():gsub("@", "")
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= player then
			if p.Name:lower():sub(1, #name) == name or p.DisplayName:lower():sub(1, #name) == name then
				return p
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Morph Function
local function applyMorphFromUserId(targetUserId)
	local myChar = player.Character
	if not myChar then return end

	local modelSuccess, model = pcall(function()
		return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromUserId(targetUserId)
	end)

	if modelSuccess and model then
		for _, item in ipairs(myChar:GetChildren()) do
			if item:IsA("Accessory") or item:IsA("Shirt") or item:IsA("Pants") or item:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or item:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
				item:Destroy()
			end
		end

		for _, item in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
			if item:IsA("Accessory") or item:IsA("Shirt") or item:IsA("Pants") or item:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or item:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
				item:Clone().Parent = myChar
			end
		end

		local modelHead = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local myHead = myChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if modelHead and myHead then
			local myMesh = myHead:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
			if myMesh then myMesh:Destroy() end

			local modelMesh = modelHead:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
			if modelMesh then
				modelMesh:Clone().Parent = myHead
			end

			local myFace = myHead:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal")
			if myFace then myFace:Destroy() end

			local modelFace = modelHead:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal")
			if modelFace then
				modelFace:Clone().Parent = myHead
			end
		end

		model:Destroy()
		Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Morph Applied!", Content = "Character morph completed successfully!", Duration = 2 })
	end
end

-- Fling Target Function
local function flingTarget(targetPlayer)
	if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then return end
	local targetRoot = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local myRoot = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	
	if targetRoot and myRoot then
		local oldPos = myRoot.CFrame
		task.spawn(function()
			for i = 1, 50 do
				myRoot.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(i * 360), 0)
				myRoot.Velocity = Vector3.new(9999, 9999, 9999)
				task.wait()
			end
			myRoot.CFrame = oldPos
			myRoot.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		end)
	end
end

-- Ban Monitor Loop
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(newPlayer)
	if bannedPlayers[newPlayer.Name:lower()] then
		if newPlayer.Character then newPlayer.Character:Destroy() end
	end
end)

---------------------------------------------------------
-- CHAT COMMANDS PROCESSOR (/fly, /morph, /kick, etc.)
---------------------------------------------------------
local function processCommand(msg)
	local args = string.split(msg, " ")
	local cmd = args[1]:lower()

	if cmd == "/fly" then
		if flying then stopFlying() else startFlying() end
		Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Cmd /fly", Content = "Fly state toggled!", Duration = 2 })

	elseif cmd == "/unlock" then
		task.spawn(function()
			loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/imshrak/rivals/refs/heads/main/main"))()
		end)
		Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Skins Unlocked!", Content = "Skin script running without closing GUI!", Duration = 3 })

	elseif cmd == "/morph" and args[2] then
		local target = findTarget(args[2])
		if target then
			applyMorphFromUserId(target.UserId)
		else
			local success, id = pcall(function() return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(args[2]) end)
			if success then applyMorphFromUserId(id) end
		end

	elseif cmd == "/kick" and args[2] then
		local target = findTarget(args[2])
		if target and target.Character then
			target.Character:Destroy()
			Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Cmd /kick", Content = target.Name .. " removed from view!", Duration = 2 })
		end

	elseif cmd == "/ban" and args[2] then
		local targetName = args[2]:lower()
		bannedPlayers[targetName] = true
		local target = findTarget(args[2])
		if target and target.Character then
			target.Character:Destroy()
		end
		Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Cmd /ban", Content = args[2] .. " added to Local Ban list!", Duration = 2 })

	elseif cmd == "/unban" and args[2] then
		local targetName = args[2]:lower()
		bannedPlayers[targetName] = nil
		Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Cmd /unban", Content = args[2] .. " unbanned!", Duration = 2 })

	elseif cmd == "/fling" and args[2] then
		local target = findTarget(args[2])
		if target then
			flingTarget(target)
			Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Cmd /fling", Content = "Flinging " .. target.Name, Duration = 2 })
		end
	end
end

-- Chat Hooks for Old & New Roblox Chat System
player.Chatted:Connect(processCommand)

pcall(function()
	if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
		TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = function(message)
			if message.TextSource and message.TextSource.UserId == player.UserId then
				processCommand(message.Text)
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- Engine Loops
RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
	if noclipEnabled and player.Character then
		for _, part in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
		end
	end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			if not flying then humanoid.WalkSpeed = walkSpeedValue end
			humanoid.JumpPower = jumpPowerValue
		end
		if spinSpeed > 0 and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(spinSpeed), 0)
		end
	end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if flying and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		local root = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
		local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
		local moveDir = humanoid and humanoid.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero
		if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
			bodyVelocity.Velocity = camera.CFrame.LookVector * (moveDir.Magnitude * speed)
		else
			bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end
end)

-- Extra Loops
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.1)
		if rainbowEnabled and player.Character then
			local hue = (tick() % 5) / 5
			local color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
			for _, part in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then part.Color = color end
			end
		end
	end
end)

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
	if infJumpEnabled and player.Character then
		local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if clickTPEnabled and not gameProcessed and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		local mouse = player:GetMouse()
		if mouse and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
		end
	end
end)

---------------------------------------------------------
-- TAB 1: MAIN CONTROLS
---------------------------------------------------------
local MainTab = Window:CreateTab("Main Controls", 4483362458)

MainTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Enable Fly (/fly)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "FlyToggle",
   Callback = function(Value)
      if Value then startFlying() else stopFlying() end
   end,
})

MainTab:CreateSlider({
   Name = "Fly Speed",
   Range = {10, 500},
   Increment = 5,
   Suffix = "Speed",
   CurrentValue = 50,
   Flag = "FlySpeedSlider",
   Callback = function(Value) speed = Value end,
})

MainTab:CreateSlider({
   Name = "WalkSpeed",
   Range = {16, 300},
   Increment = 1,
   Suffix = "Speed",
   CurrentValue = 16,
   Flag = "WalkSpeedSlider",
   Callback = function(Value) walkSpeedValue = Value end,
})

MainTab:CreateSlider({
   Name = "Jump Power",
   Range = {50, 300},
   Increment = 5,
   Suffix = "Power",
   CurrentValue = 50,
   Flag = "JumpPowerSlider",
   Callback = function(Value) jumpPowerValue = Value end,
})

MainTab:CreateSlider({
   Name = "Spinbot Speed",
   Range = {0, 200},
   Increment = 5,
   Suffix = "RPM",
   CurrentValue = 0,
   Flag = "SpinSlider",
   Callback = function(Value) spinSpeed = Value end,
})

MainTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Low Gravity Mode",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "GravityToggle",
   Callback = function(Value) Workspace.Gravity = Value and 40 or 196.2 end,
})

MainTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Infinite Jump",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "InfJumpMainToggle",
   Callback = function(Value) infJumpEnabled = Value end,
})

MainTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Enable Anti-AFK",
   Callback = function()
      local virtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
      player.Idled:Connect(function()
         virtualUser:CaptureController()
         virtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
      end)
      Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Anti-AFK", Content = "Anti-AFK Enabled!", Duration = 2 })
   end,
})

MainTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Rejoin Server",
   Callback = function() TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, player) end,
})

MainTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Server Hop",
   Callback = function() TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId) end,
})

---------------------------------------------------------
-- TAB 2: PLAYER MORPH
---------------------------------------------------------
local MorphTab = Window:CreateTab("Player Morph", 4483362458)

local morphUsername = ""

MorphTab:CreateInput({
   Name = "Morph Username (/morph <name>)",
   PlaceholderText = "Enter Username...",
   RemoveTextOnFocusLost = false,
   Callback = function(Text) morphUsername = Text end,
})

MorphTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Morph By Username",
   Callback = function()
      if morphUsername == "" then return end
      local target = findTarget(morphUsername)
      if target then
         applyMorphFromUserId(target.UserId)
      else
         local success, id = pcall(function() return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(morphUsername) end)
         if success then applyMorphFromUserId(id) end
      end
   end,
})

MorphTab:CreateDropdown({
   Name = "Preset Avatars",
   Options = {"Builderman (156)", "Shedletsky (261)", "Telamon (261)", "Roblox (1)"},
   CurrentOption = {"Builderman (156)"},
   MultipleOptions = false,
   Flag = "PresetMorphDropdown",
   Callback = function(Option)
      local selected = Option[1]
      if selected:find("156") then applyMorphFromUserId(156)
      elseif selected:find("261") then applyMorphFromUserId(261)
      elseif selected:find("1") then applyMorphFromUserId(1) end
   end,
})

MorphTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Remove Clothing",
   Callback = function()
      if player.Character then
         for _, item in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Shirt") or item:IsA("Pants") or item:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then item:Destroy() end
         end
      end
   end,
})

MorphTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Remove Accessories",
   Callback = function()
      if player.Character then
         for _, item in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Accessory") then item:Destroy() end
         end
      end
   end,
})

---------------------------------------------------------
-- TAB 3: ADMIN PANEL (WITH CHAT COMMAND CONTROLS)
---------------------------------------------------------
local AdminTab = Window:CreateTab("Admin Panel", 4483362458)

local targetInput = ""

AdminTab:CreateInput({
   Name = "Target Player Username",
   PlaceholderText = "@Username",
   RemoveTextOnFocusLost = false,
   Callback = function(Text) targetInput = Text end,
})

AdminTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Kick Target (/kick)",
   Callback = function()
      local target = findTarget(targetInput)
      if target and target.Character then
         target.Character:Destroy()
         Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Admin Kick", Content = target.Name .. " kicked!", Duration = 2 })
      end
   end,
})

AdminTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Ban Target (/ban)",
   Callback = function()
      if targetInput ~= "" then
         bannedPlayers[targetInput:lower()] = true
         local target = findTarget(targetInput)
         if target and target.Character then target.Character:Destroy() end
         Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Admin Ban", Content = targetInput .. " banned!", Duration = 2 })
      end
   end,
})

AdminTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Unban Target (/unban)",
   Callback = function()
      if targetInput ~= "" then
         bannedPlayers[targetInput:lower()] = nil
         Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Admin Unban", Content = targetInput .. " unbanned!", Duration = 2 })
      end
   end,
})

AdminTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Fling Target (/fling)",
   Callback = function()
      local target = findTarget(targetInput)
      if target then flingTarget(target) end
   end,
})

AdminTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Teleport To Target",
   Callback = function()
      local target = findTarget(targetInput)
      local myRoot = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if target and target.Character and myRoot then
         local tRoot = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
         if tRoot then myRoot.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3) end
      end
   end,
})

AdminTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Click Teleport Tool",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "ClickTPToggleAdmin",
   Callback = function(Value) clickTPEnabled = Value end,
})

AdminTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Spectate Target Toggle",
   Callback = function()
      local target = findTarget(targetInput)
      if target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
         spectating = not spectating
         camera.CameraSubject = spectating and target.Character.Humanoid or (player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid"))
      end
   end,
})

AdminTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "ESP Highlight Target",
   Callback = function()
      if currentHighlight then currentHighlight:Destroy() end
      local target = findTarget(targetInput)
      if target and target.Character then
         local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
         hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
         hl.Parent = target.Character
         currentHighlight = hl
      end
   end,
})

AdminTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Noclip Walls",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "NoclipAdminToggle",
   Callback = function(Value) noclipEnabled = Value end,
})

AdminTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Invisible (Local Character)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "InvisAdminToggle",
   Callback = function(Value)
      if player.Character then
         for _, v in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") or v:IsA("Decal") then
               v.LocalTransparencyModifier = Value and 1 or 0
            end
         end
      end
   end,
})

AdminTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Give Classic Btools",
   Callback = function()
      local t1, t2, t3 = Instance.new("HopperBin", player.Backpack), Instance.new("HopperBin", player.Backpack), Instance.new("HopperBin", player.Backpack)
      t1.BinType, t2.BinType, t3.BinType = Enum.BinType.Clone, Enum.BinType.Hammer, Enum.BinType.Grab
   end,
})

---------------------------------------------------------
-- TAB 4: SKINS & COSMETICS
---------------------------------------------------------
local SkinsTab = Window:CreateTab("Skins & Unlocker", 4483362458)

SkinsTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Unlock All Skins (/unlock)",
   Callback = function()
      task.spawn(function()
         loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/imshrak/rivals/refs/heads/main/main"))()
      end)
      Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Skins Unlocked!", Content = "Skin Script loaded without closing GUI!", Duration = 3 })
   end,
})

SkinsTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Unlock Weapon Utility (Backup)",
   Callback = function()
      task.spawn(function()
         loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EdgeIY/infiniteyield/master/source"))()
      end)
   end,
})

SkinsTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Rainbow Skin Loop",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "RainbowSkinToggle",
   Callback = function(Value) rainbowEnabled = Value end,
})

SkinsTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Force Neon Material",
   Callback = function()
      if player.Character then
         for _, v in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.Material = Enum.Material.Neon end
         end
      end
   end,
})

---------------------------------------------------------
-- TAB 5: CAMERA & VISUALS
---------------------------------------------------------
local VisualsTab = Window:CreateTab("Camera & Visuals", 4483362458)

VisualsTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Fullbright (No Shadows)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "FullbrightVisualToggle",
   Callback = function(Value)
      fullbrightEnabled = Value
      Lighting.Brightness = fullbrightEnabled and 2 or originalBrightness
      Lighting.ClockTime = fullbrightEnabled and 14 or originalClockTime
      Lighting.GlobalShadows = not fullbrightEnabled
   end,
})

VisualsTab:CreateSlider({
   Name = "Field Of View (FOV)",
   Range = {70, 120},
   Increment = 1,
   Suffix = "FOV",
   CurrentValue = 70,
   Flag = "FOVSliderVisual",
   Callback = function(Value) camera.FieldOfView = Value end,
})

VisualsTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Remove Fog / Boost Graphics",
   Callback = function()
      Lighting.FogEnd = 9e9
      for _, v in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
         if v:IsA("Atmosphere") or v:IsA("PostEffect") then v:Destroy() end
      end
   end,
})

scripts.title: ESP, Aimbot, Silent Aim & Triggerbot | Free, No Key
scripts.features:
ESP and aim tools for Hypershot. Open the panel, switch on what you want - it works against bots and real players alike, in team modes, free for all and duels.

FEATURES
- Bot detection: the game fills servers with bots that carry real-looking names. Every one is marked [BOT], every real player [P]
- ESP: box, name, the weapon they hold, health bar (200 HP), distance, spawn protection, head dot, skeleton, tracers and chams, with a wall check and optional teammates
- Aim assist: drives the game's own camera angles, so there is no mouse calibration. FOV, separate horizontal and vertical smoothing, sticky target, head / body / nearest, visible only and auto fire
- Triggerbot: goes through the game's own click path, so it works on mobile too
- Silent aim: bends the shot itself toward the target, with its own FOV circle and hotkey. Off by default
- Gun mods: no recoil, no spread, no viewmodel kick and a rapid fire multiplier
- Movement: WalkSpeed and Fly
- Humaniser page: turn speed cap, reaction delay, Legit / Normal / Raw presets and a panic key
- Duels are recorded, so silent aim and the gun mods pause there by default

MOBILE
Works on PC and mobile - the panel asks once and scales itself, in German, English and Russian.
